title: Behavior Follow Mob
description: Allows the mob to follow other mobs.

filters.description: If non-empty, provides criteria for filtering which nearby Mobs can be followed.

preferred_actor_type.description: The type of actor to prefer following. If left unspecified, a random actor among those in range will be chosen.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

stop_distance.description: Distance in blocks at which the entity stops following.

use_home_position_restriction.description: If true, the mob will respect the 'minecraft:home' component's 'restriction_radius' field when choosing a target to follow.
